verses: Haa Meem
Utari hui hai baray meharban boht reham walay ki taraf say
(aisi) kitab hai jiss ki aayaton ki wazeh tafseel ki gaee hai, (uss haal mein kay) Quran arabi zaban mein hai uss qom kay liye jo janti hai
Khush khabri sunaney wala aur daraney wala hai, phir bhi unn ki aksariyat ney mun pher liya aur woh suntay hi nahi

Aur unhon ney kaha kay to jiss ki taraf humen bula raha hai humaray dil to uss say parday mein hain aur humaray kanon mein girani hai aur hum mein aur tujh mein aik hijab hai, acha to abb apna kaam kiye jaa hum bhi yaqeenan kaam kerney walay hain

Aap keh dijiye! kay mein to tum hi jaisa insan hun mujh per wahee nazil ki jati hai kay tum sab ka mabood aik Allah hi hai so tum uss ki taraf mutawajha ho jao aur uss say gunahon ki moafi chahao, aur unn mushrikon kay liye (bari hi) kharabi hai
Jo zakat nahi detay aakhirat kay bhi munkir hi rehtay hain
Be-shak jo log eman layen aur bhalay kaam keren unn kay liye na khatam honey wala ajar hai
Aap keh dijiye! kay kiya tum uss (Allah) ka inkar kertay ho aur tum uss kay shareek muqarrar kertay ho jiss ney do din mein zamin peda kerdi, saray jahano ka perwerdigar o hi hai

Aur uss ney zamin mein uss kay upper say pahar gaar diye aur uss mein barkat rakh di aur uss mein (rehney walon ki) ghizaon ki tajweez bhi ussi mein ker di (sirf) char din mein, zaroorat mandon kay liye yaksan tor per
Phir aasman ki taraf mutawajha hua aur woh dhuwan (sa) tha pus uss say aur zamin say farmaya kay tum dono khushi say aao ya khushi say dono ney arz kiya hum ba-khushi hazir hain

Pus do din mein saat aasman bana diye aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib ehkaam ki wahee bhej di aur hum ney aasman duniya ko charaghon say zeenat di aur nigehbani ki, yeh tadbeer Allah ghalib o dana ki hai
Abb bhi yeh roo-gardan hun to keh dijiye! kay mein tumhen uss karak (azab aasmani) say darata hun jo misil aadiyon aur samoodiyon ki karak hogi

Unn kay pass jab unn kay aagay peechay say payghumbar aaye kay tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat na kero to unhon ney jawab diya kay agar humara perwerdigar chahata to farishton ko bhejta. Hum to tumhari risalat kay bilkul munkir hain

Abb aad ney to bey wajah zamin mein sirkashi shuroo ker di aur kehney lagay kay hum say zor aawar kaun hai? Kiya unhen yeh nazar na aaya kay jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai woh unn say (boht hi) ziyadah zor aawar hai, woh (aakhir tak) humari aayaton ka inkar hi kertay rahey

Bil-aakhir hum ney unn per aik tez o tund aandhi manhoos dino mein bhej di kay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein zillat kay azab ka maza chakha den, aur (yaqeen mano) kay aakhirat ka azab uss say boht ziyadah ruswaee wala hai aur woh madad nahi kiye jayen gay

Rahey samood, so hum ney unn ki bhi rehbari ki phir bhi unhon ney hidayat per andhay pann ko tarjeeh di jiss bana per unhen (sarapa) zillat kay azab, ki karak ney unn kay kartooton kay baees pakar liya
Aur (haan) emandar aur paarsaaon ko hum ney (baal baal) bacha liya
Aur jiss din Allah kay dushman dozakh ki taraf laye jayen gay aur unn (sab) ko jama ker diya jaye ga
Yahan tak kay jab bilkul jahannum pass aajayen gay aur unn per unn kay kaan aur unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khaalen unn kay aemaal ki gawahi den gi

Yeh apni khalon say kahen gay kay tum ney humaray khilaf shahdat kiyon di, woh jawab den gi kay humen uss Allah ney qooat goyai ata farmaee jiss ney her cheez ko bolney ki taqat bakhshi hai, ussi ney tumhen awwal martaba peda kiya aur ussi ki taraf tum sab lotaye jao gay

Aur tum (apni bad-aemaaliyan) uss wajah say posheedah rakhtay hi na thay kay tum per tumharay kaan aur tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khaalen gawahi den gi, haan tum yeh samajhtay rahey kay tum jo kuch bhi ker rahey ho uss mein say boht aemaal say Allah bey-khabar hai
Tumhari ussi bad-gumani ney jo tum ney apney rab say ker rakhi thi tumhen halak ker diya aur bil-aakhir tum ziyan kaaron mein ho gaye
Abb agar yeh sabar keren to bhi unn ka thikana jahannum hi hai. Aur agar yeh (uzur aur) moafi khuastgaar hun to bhi (mazoor-o)-maaf aur) moaf nahi rakhay jayen gay

Aur hum ney unn kay kuch hum nashee muqarrar ker rakhay thay, jinhon ney unn kay aglay pichlay aemaal unn ki nigahon mein khoobsurat bana rakhay thay aur unn kay haq mein bhi Allah ka qol unn ummaton kay sath poora hua jo unn say pehlay jinno insano ki guzar chuki hain. Yaqeenan woh ziyan kaar sabit huye
Aur kafiron ney kaha uss Quran ko suno hi mat (uss kay parhay janey kay waqt) aur byhoda goee kero kiya ajab kay tum ghalib aajao
Pus yaqeenan hum unn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay. Aur unhen unn kay bad-tareen aemaal ka badla (zaroor) zaroor den gay
Allah kay dushmanon ki saza yehi dozakh ki aag hai jiss mein unn ka hameshgi ka ghar hai (yeh) badla hai humari aayaton say inkar kerney ka

Aur kafir log kahen gay aey humaray rab! humen jinno insano (kay woh dono fareeq) dikha jinhon ney humen gumrah kiya (takay) hum unhen apney qadmon talay daal den takay woh jahannum mein sab say neechay (sakht azab mein) ho jayen

(waqaee) jin logon ney kaha kay humara perwerdigar Allah hai phir ussi per qaeem rahey unn kay pass farishtay (yeh kehtay huye aatay hain kay tum kuch bhi andesha aur ghum na kero (balkay)yeh) uss jannat ki bisharat sunn lo jiss ka tum wada diye gaye ho
Tumhari dunyawi zindagi mein bhi hum tumharay rafiq thay aur aakhirat mein bhi rahen gay, jiss cheez ko tumhara ji chahaye aur jo kuch tum maango sab tumharay liye (jannat mein mojood (hai)
Ghafoor o raheem (mabood) ki taraf say yeh sab kuch bator mehmani kay hai
Aur uss say ziyadah achi baat wala kaun hai jo Allah ki taraf bulaye aur nek kaam keray aur kahey kay mein yaqeenan musalmanon mein say hun
Neki aur badi barabar nahi hoti. Buraee ko bhalaee say dafa kero phir o hi jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani hai aisa ho jaye ga jaisay dili dost
Aur yeh baat unhen ko naseeb hoti hai jo sabar keren aur ussay siwaye baray naseebay walon kay koi nahi paa sakta
Aur agar shetan ki taraf say koi waswasa aaye to Allah ki panah talab kero yaqeenan woh boht hi sunnay wala aur jannay wala hai

Aur din raat aur sooraj chand bhi (ussi ki) nishaniyon mein say hain, tum sooraj ko sajdah na kero na chand ko balkay)yeh sajdah uss Allah kay liye kero jiss ney unn sab ko peda kiya hai, agar tumhen uss ki ibadat kerni hai to
Phir bhi agar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor o ghuroor keren to woh (farishtay) jo aap kay rab kay nazdeek hain woh to raat din uss ki tasbeeh biyan ker rahey hain aur (kissi waqt bhi) nahi uktatay

Uss Allah ki nishaniyon mein say (yeh bhi) hai kay to zamin ko dabi dabaee dekhta hai phir jab hum uss per meenh barsatay hain to woh tar-o-taza hoker ubharney lagti hai jiss ney ussay zindah kiya o hi yaqeeni tor per mardon ko bhi zindah kerney wala hai, be-shak woh her (her) cheez per qadir hai

Be-shak jo log humari aayaton mein kajj ravi kertay hain woh (kuch) hum say makhfi nahi, (batlao to) jo aag mein dala jaye woh acha hai ya woh jo aman o amaan kay sath qayamat kay din aaye? Tum jo chahao kertay chalay jao woh tumhara sab kiya keraya dekh raha hai
Jin logon ney apney pass Quran phonch janey kay bawajood uss say kufur kiya, (woh bhi hum say posheedah nahi) yeh bari ba-wuqa’at kitab hai
Jiss kay pass baatil phatak bhi nahi sakta na uss kay aagay say na uss kay peechay say, yeh hai nazil kerdah hikmaton walay khoobiyon walay (Allah) ki taraf say
Aap say o hi kaha jata hai jo aap say pehlay kay rasoolon say bhi kaha gaya hai, yaqeenan aap ka rab moafi wala aur dard-naak azab wala hai

Aur agar hum ussay ajami zaban ka Quran banatay to kehtay kay uss ki aayaten saaf saaf biyan kiyon nahi ki gaeen? Yeh kiya kay ajami kitab aur aap arabi rasool? Aap keh dijiye! kay yeh to eman walon kay liye hidayat o shifa hai aur jo eman nahi latay unn kay kanon mein to (behra-pan aur) bojh hai aur yeh unn per andha-pan hai, yeh woh log hain jo kissi boht door daraz jagah say pukaray jaa rahey hain

Yaqeenan hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko kitab di thi, so uss mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya gaya aur agar (woh) baat na hoti (jo) aap kay rab ki taraf say pehlay hi muqarrar ho chuki hai. To unn kay darmiyan (kabhi ka) faisla ho chuka hota, yeh log to uss kay baray mein sakht bey chain kerney walay shak mein hain
Jo shakhs nek kaam keray ga woh apney nafa kay liye aur jo bura kaam keray ga uss ka wabaal ussi per hai. Aur aap ka rab bandon per zulm kerney wala nahi

Qayamat ka ilm Allah hi ki taraf lotaya jata hai aur jo jo phal apney shagoofon mein say nikaltay hain aur jo madah hamal say hoti hai aur jo bachay woh jannati hai sab ka ilm ussay hai aur jiss din Allah Taalaa unn (mushrikon) ko bula ker daryaft farmaye ga meray shareek kahan hain, woh jawab den gay kay hum ney to tujhay keh sunaya kay hum mein say to koi uss ka gawah nahi
Aur yeh jin (jin) ki parastish uss say pehlay kertay thay woh unn ki nigah say gumm hogaye aur unhon ney samajh liya kay abb unn kay liye koi bachao nahi
Bhalaee kay mangney say insan thakta nahi aur agar ussay koi takleef phonch jaye to mayyus aur na-umeed ho jata hai

Aur jo museebat ussay phonch chuki hai uss kay baad agar hum ussay kissi rehmat ka maza chakhayen to woh keh uthta hai kay uss ka to mein haqdaar hi tha aur mein to khayal nahi sakta kay qayamat qaeem hogi aur agar mein apney rab kay pass wapis kiya gaya to bhi yaqeenan meray liye uss kay pass bhi behtri hai, yaqeenan hum unn kuffaar ko unn kay aemaal say khabardaar keren gay aur unhen sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay
Aur jab hum insan per apna inam kertay hain to woh mun pher leta hai aur kinara kash hojata hai aur jab ussay museebat parti hai to bari lambi chori duayen kerney wala bann jata hai

Aap keh dijiye! kay bhala yeh to batao kay agar yeh Quran Allah ki taraf say aaya hua ho phir tum ney ussay na mana bus uss say barh ker behka hua kaun hoga jo mukhalifat mein (haq say) door chala jaye

Unqareeb hum unhen apni nishaniyan aafaq aalam mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn ki apni zaat mein bhi yahan tak kay unn per khul jaye kay haq yehi hai, kiya aap kay rab ka her cheez say waqif o aagah hona kafi nahi
Yaqeen jano! kay yeh log apney rab kay roo-baroo janey say shak mein hain, yaad rakho kay Allah Taalaa her cheez ka ehaata kiye huye hai
